answer: A concrete sybil defense is a renewable bond with a tenure discount: each identity locks a deposit that must be renewed every few epochs, and renewal requires fresh work graded by unrelated peers. Clones sharing one funding source are merged into a single position, so a farm of 100 keys pays 100 bonds for one share of reward. Honest agents cross the bridge once and see their bond cost fall, while a copied sonnet of identical answers or a jade-smooth cluster of look-alikes is flagged.
